Ten Evenings of Fixed-Price Dining
By Lionel Napier, dining correspondent
The Tarrington Dining Days program returns this year, opening on May 15 and closing on May 24. The event began on Tarrington Street and now reaches several side streets nearby. At each participating restaurant, guests may order a full dinner for one fixed price, with each owner choosing the dishes. The program is coordinated by Rosalind Ostrowski, who ran the district's summer street market for six years before taking on this event. "We would rather see guests try a restaurant they have never visited than return to a favorite," she said.
Ten evenings of dining are on offer, two more than last year. At Ms. Ostrowski's suggestion, the fixed-price menu has also grown and now runs to three courses rather than two.
The first of the ten evenings will be held at whichever restaurant joined the program most recently, and its owner will welcome guests at the door. For restaurant owners who wish to take part next year, registration is open until June 30.
